label: Мнение
description: A 10-sentence usage card for мнение with argument, contrast, and social talk.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Possessive opinion (nominative). 1. 'Моё' agrees with neuter 'мнение' in the nominative. 2. 'Личное' adds a softening hedge. 3. A high-frequency frame for stating a view without claiming authority.

missions.phrase: Для меня твоё мнение очень важно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Social evaluation (nominative subject). 1. 'Твоё мнение' is the neuter nominative subject. 2. 'Важно' carries the predicate weight. 3. Natural in meetings and personal conversations alike.
Strategic focus: Source of a view (nominative). 1. 'Мнение' stays nominative as the logical subject of 'интересно'. 2. 'Друга' (genitive) names whose opinion it is. 3. A reusable relational phrase.

missions.phrase: У меня есть своё мнение об этом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Possession frame (nominative). 1. 'У меня есть' is the standard Russian have-structure, taking the nominative. 2. 'Мнение' is the thing possessed. 3. Strong sentence for debate.

missions.phrase: По моему мнению, он совершенно прав.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Fixed opinion marker (prepositional). 1. 'По' here governs the dative 'мнению' in this set phrase. 2. 'По моему мнению' is a top discourse opener. 3. Essential for any serious set.

missions.phrase: Я совсем не согласен с этим мнением.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Argument language (instrumental). 1. 'Не согласен' signals disagreement. 2. 'С мнением' takes the instrumental after 'с'. 3. A very useful real conversational sentence.
Strategic focus: Change over time (nominative subject). 1. 'Мнение' is the neuter nominative subject of 'меняется'. 2. 'Со временем' frames the gradual shift. 3. Useful for reasoning and discussion.
Strategic focus: Requesting input (accusative). 1. 'Мнение' is the direct object; neuter accusative matches the nominative. 2. 'Спрашиваю' is a practical first-person verb. 3. Simple and social.

missions.phrase: Какое у тебя мнение о книге?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Aboutness question (nominative). 1. 'Мнение' is nominative inside the 'у тебя' frame. 2. 'О книге' is the standard 'about the book' shape. 3. Ideal for review and discussion language.

missions.phrase: У всех нас разное мнение об этом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Contrast in thought (nominative). 1. 'Разное' describes differing views, agreeing with neuter 'мнение'. 2. 'Мнение' is the nominative anchor. 3. Strong phrase for debate and comparison.
